TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Specifies the date/time on which the trade was executed.

OpeningSettlementDate.name: Opening Settlement Date
OpeningSettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the securities are to be delivered or received.

NumberOfDaysAccrued.name: Number Of Days Accrued
NumberOfDaysAccrued.definition: Number of days on which the interest rate accrues (daily accrual note).

InstructionProcessingAdditionalDetails.name: Instruction Processing Additional Details
InstructionProcessingAdditionalDetails.definition: Provides additional settlement processing information which can not be included within the structured fields of the message.

TradeDateTimeUTCRule.definition: If Trade Date/Time is used with a time or a time + UTC indicator, then it must be the local time of the place of trade, for example, of the stock exchange, or of the selling broker for OTC.

AdditionalDetailsRule.definition: Unless bilaterally agreed between the sender and receiver, if InstructionProcessingAdditionalDetails is present, then it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.
